d: Delicious garden, bordering on one side with the park, and on the other with a main road, in which you pass through a majestic gate. Small climbs in the garden, on which some green seats shaded by a few trees, one of which is close to the road leading to the hills, from which you go to the village, not far from the castle of the Count. Nina, who sleeps, but not seen. Susanna is staged with George and with some Villani and Villane; others of them van going up and others descending from the nearby hills.
George with other Villani, and the Count.

Nina simply dressed, with loose hair, and with a bunch of flowers in her hand. Her step is unequal, and sighing, without saying anything, she then sits on the porch, facing the gate, which answers the street
The Villanas run, and Susanna brings a basket with fruit, and other small gifts, which are distributed by Nina to the aforementioned Villanelles.
Inside shepherd who plays, then goes out with other Villani in due time.
Lindoro down, without a hat, and hurled, led by the servants, and by the Count's Hunting Guards, and sayings.
The Count, who returns from the same road from which he departed, accompanied by his servants and hunting guards, is said.

Nina drops from the hills, holding a small Villanella for one hand, and for the other an old Villano, accompanied by many other Villani, and Villane, all bringing several gifts, received by her. Susanna follows her from afar, and stops on the next hill.
